title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO after Trump intervenes
summary_full: Chipmaker reverses decision to remove chief executive after US president ‘convinced’ its boardComment: Nvidia’s humiliated board should resign out of embarrassmentBusiness live – latest updatesUS politics – live updatesNvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive after Donald Trump directly intervened with the US AI chipmaker’s board of directors, in a stunning reversal of the tech billionaire’s downfall.Speaking on Monday shortly after Nvidia’s surprise announcement that Huang had been restored to the top job – less than two weeks after he resigned – Trump said that he had “convinced” the board to do it. “I made the deal,” he told CNBC. Huang had resigned after reports of extramarital affairs, including with an alleged Chinese spy and two Nvidia employees. Continue reading...
